To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a new backlight inverter can drive multiple cold cathode fluorescent lamps using a single controller and a single switching network.

(1) A backlight inverter, in which multiple CCFLs can be driven using single controller and switching network, is proposed; (2) The current distribution of CCFLs can easily be analyzed using equivalent circuits, and the current-balancing condition is derived; (3) The current distribution is affected by the lamp voltage variation and the resonant capacitor deviation; and (4) The analysis results are validated through experiments with multiple CCFLs.
